buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and

Commissioning of Goods 2. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must be an Original Equipment Manufacturer OEM or a GeM authorized channel partner. 2. Bidders must upload a valid ink signed Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF explicit to this specific GeM Bid Number. 3. Bidders must upload a comprehensive Material Safety Data Sheet MSDS for every chemical offered. 4. Brands quoted by the bidder must strictly match the items delivered equivalent or substitute chemical formulations will be rejected. 5. All hygiene and chemical items must possess a minimum 80 percentage residual shelf life at the time of physical delivery to the consignee. 6. Every individual packaging container must explicitly display the manufacturers mark chemical name brand Batch Lot Number Manufacturing Date and Expiry Date. 7. The seller must replace any rejected or substandard chemical batches at their own expense within 7 days of official intimation. 8. The bidder must upload an undertaking confirming they are not under liquidation court receivership or bankruptcy. 9. Bidders are required to cross-verify and declare correct GST rates where Reverse Charge Mechanism RCM applies it must conform to GeM Portal Rules. 10. A self declaration affidavit on company letterhead confirming that the firm has not been blacklisted by any Central State Government body must be submitted. 11. Valid GSTIN registration and PAN card copies. 12.Signed OEM Authorization Certificate MAF. 13. Non submission of the MSDS for any item will result in technical rejection of the entire bid. 14. Samples must be delivered to the buyers office within 3 days of notification on the GeM portal. 15. Failure to submit samples or failure of the sample in physical testing will lead to technical disqualification. 16. All Sellers should attend pre bid meeting failure will lead to rejection. .
